Copyright stays with the named manufacturer/supplier; no open redistribution license is asserted. Required attribution is manufacturer, document title/revision and URL as listed. Our adaptations are the proposed raw-node crowbar, regenerative latch, capacitor sizing and mathematical models described in `docs/evidence/v1a_lite/PHASE_C2_REVISION.md`; no CAD adaptation occurred.
